boxes.text: MappingPage
baseline 03f2168, before tldraw

[MappingPocPage]
services --> MappingServicesContext --> MappingWorkspacePage
DiagramService [G]       content creation / revision / generation
CanvasHistoryService [E] document + view history
WorkspaceStorage        injected or page-owned

[Startup / restore]
project representations + storage.load()
saved workspace --> restore / reconcile --> drafts
requested or first settled representation --> open

[CanvasWorkspace]
drafts[documentId] --> CanvasDraft = DraftMetadata + CanvasSession
controllers       --> controller lookup by documentId
dirtyScenes       --> IDs whose scenes differ from saved baselines
setDrafts         --> create / subscribe / replace / dispose sessions

[CanvasSession]
owns controller; publishes read-only stores synchronously
document      --> MappingGridDocument
presentation  --> display + diagramViews
selection     --> SelectionState
controls      --> focus + action surfaces
geometry      --> endpointBounds + cell + version
status        --> isDirty, sceneDirty, canUndo, canRedo

[MappingDocumentController]
ControllerSnapshot
contextId + canvasRevisionId + version + canUndo / canRedo
document + canvas + runtime cell / endpointBounds

[MappingGridDocument]
scene: LineGridScene [A]
root: GridBox
contents[contentId]: Diagram [B]
edges: DiagramConnection[]
jumps?: CanvasJump[]
sections[contentId]

[MappingCanvasState]
selection: SelectionState
items in insertion order
whole diagram OR captured region
diagramViews[displayNodeId]
revision + collapsed node IDs
display: DisplayState [C]
rootIds + nodes: FloatingPane
controls: MappingControls
activeBoxId / selectionFocusId
activeThreadId / surfaces

[canvasDisplayNodes]
read-only registry over scene + canvas; cloned results
grid:<boxId>   diagram / group; cells; resolved GridBox bounds
floating:<id>  stored panes; pixels; canvas / viewport space
floating:edge:* arrows from edges + folds + endpoint geometry

[Mounted document view]
SourcePaneDocumentContext + SourcePaneDocumentActiveContext
DraggableDiagramCanvas --> MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
camera / focus
selection / edits / jumps / undo
visited documents stay mounted; inactive or hidden views are hidden

[Page tools]
MappingSubmenu          --> create / name / save
MappingDiagramExplorer --> open / focus / delete / copy or move
DiagramSearchPanel     <-- saved + draft + proposal documents
ChangeSessionPreview   <-- changeMode
DiagramEditComposer    <-- DiagramEditCoordinator

[Agent access]
useAgentCanvasBridge --> handleAgentCommand --> controller [D]
context / document-state / snapshot / apply / apply-diagram-revision
create-document / copy-document / saved baseline acknowledgement

[SourcePaneViewState]
pane scroll + camera --> captureDisplay / captureCamera
live view state sampled for storage; 250 ms change notification

[Persistence and publication]
checkpoint changed --> CanvasSession.onCommit --> workspace.onPersist
WorkspacePersistence --> RecordStorage --> WorkspaceStorage worker [E]
capture() --> MappingWorkspaceSnapshot {schemaVersion: 3}
projectId + activeDocumentId + transfers + documents[]
project save --> acknowledgement updates captured saved baseline
transfer / linked undo-redo --> save --> install workspace

[Selection and dirty-state boundaries]
captured region: sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId / sourceAscii
rect / selectedIds; reducer deduplicates membership
focus + surfaces belong to controls; panels belong to display
sceneDirty = scene differs; isDirty also compares edges and name
document store changes refresh search/explorer draft entries
